text:
```yaml
name: Index Translations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install pyparsing whoosh pytest
        
    - name: Download Quranic resources
      run: |
        make download
    
    - name: Build indexes
      run: |
        make build
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest -vv --rootdir=src/ src/tests/test_outputs.py src/tests/test_index_api.py
    
    - name: Verify translations.json exists
      run: |
        ls -la src/alfanous/configs/translations.json
    
    - name: Verify API function exists
      run: |
        python -c "import src.alfanous.api; print('API function available:', hasattr(src.alfanous.api, 'index_translations'))"
```
